reason: After the patch, `create` and `update` in app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:22-47 read only top-level `params[:name]`, `params[:visible]` and `params[:alias_level]`; the removed `group.usernames = params[:group][:usernames]` / `payload[:usernames]` lines mean `group[usernames]` is silently dropped.
